items.exampleEn: Please enclose a photo with your form.
items.exampleZh: 請在表格裡附上一張照片。

items.exampleEn: She rearranged the books on the shelf by color.
items.exampleZh: 她把書架上的書按顏色重新排列。

items.exampleEn: Getting a visa can be a long process.
items.exampleZh: 申請簽證可能是一段漫長的過程。

items.exampleEn: Even a small movement can wake the baby.
items.exampleZh: 即使一個小小的動作也會吵醒寶寶。

items.exampleEn: Food prices rose again this month.
items.exampleZh: 這個月食物價格又上漲了。

items.exampleEn: This old wall protects the village from strong winds.
items.exampleZh: 這道老牆保護村子不受強風吹襲。

items.exampleEn: Mistakes often occur when people work too fast.
items.exampleZh: 人們做事太快時，常常會出錯。

items.sentenceEn: Any movement in the room turns on the lights.
items.sentenceZh: 房間裡只要有一點動靜，燈就會亮。

items.audioEn: The office will be closed on Monday because we need to rearrange all the furniture.
items.audioZh: 辦公室星期一不開放，因為我們得重新擺放所有的家具。
items.questionZh: 辦公室星期一為什麼不開放？
options: To move to a new building.

items.sentenceEn: There has been a big rise in the number of tourists.
Learning a language is a slow process, so be patient.
items.sentenceZh: 學語言是一個緩慢的過程，所以要有耐心。

items.stemEn: Wear a hat to ____ your skin.
items.stemZh: 戴頂帽子來保護你的皮膚。
這個問題最早是什麼時候發生的？

items.passageEn: Mr. Chen wanted to protect his small garden from his neighbor's dog, so he decided to enclose it with a low fence. The whole process took two weekends and involved the whole family. First, they rearranged the flower pots. Then they built the fence. A problem occurred on the second day: it rained heavily. But the sun rose bright the next morning, and they finished the job. Now the fence keeps the dog out of the garden.
items.passageZh: 陳先生想保護他的小花園不被鄰居的狗破壞，所以決定用矮籬笆把它圍起來。整個過程花了兩個週末，全家人都參與了。他們先重新擺放花盆，再搭籬笆。第二天發生了一個問題：雨下得很大。不過隔天早上太陽升起、天氣晴朗，他們就把工作完成了。現在籬笆讓那隻狗進不了花園。

questions.questionZh: 陳先生為什麼要把花園圍起來？
options: 因為鄰居要求他這樣做
防止鄰居的狗進來破壞

questions.questionZh: 第二天發生了什麼問題？

items.promptZh: 這個問題常常在早上發生。
referenceEn: This problem often occurs in the morning.
The problem frequently occurs in the morning.
rubricZh: occur 表示「發生」，是不及物動詞，後面不接受詞
主詞是第三人稱單數，動詞用 occurs
寫 happens 意思也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 protect 造一個句子，說說你會怎麼保護自己或你在乎的東西。
referenceEn: I keep my money in the bank to protect it.
I use a strong password to protect my phone.
rubricZh: protect 表示「保護」，可直接接受詞（例如 protect my money）
也可用 protect A from B（例如 protect my phone from water）
例如用 to＋原形動詞說明目的，其他合理寫法也接受
